title: The Will of Greywater Bay
author: Mara Oyelaran
blurb: Tamsin Kavanagh, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
